replay.time_basis: UTC. Track times are segment boundaries from departure plus evaluated segment durations. Segment eta values are midpoint times.
replay.height_reference: Display only: pressure altitude converted to metres above the WGS84 ellipsoid without temperature or geoid correction
replay.interpolation: Constant groundspeed along the geodesic between adjacent track points
